Quick-Cactus
CR 7

What you thought was a cactus suddenly springs to life and rushes toward you in a blur.

XP 9,600
N Small plant
Init +10; Senses bloodsense 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 21, flat-footed 12 (+10 Dex, +2 natural, +1 dodge)
hp 75 (8d8+36)
Fort +10, Ref +12, Will +4
Immune plant traits; Weaknesses water-weak

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee 2 slams +17 (1d4 plus bleed)
Special Attacks bleed (1d4), needle spray

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 30, Con 18, Int 3, Wis 14, Cha 10
Base Attack +6; CMB +5, CMD 25
Feats Ability Focus (needle spray), Dodge, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +14, Perception +10, Stealth +25
SQ freeze (as cactus), piercing needles

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bloodsense (Ex)

The quick-cactus can detect creatures who have blood as if they have blindsight.

Needle Spray (Ex)

The quick-cactus shoots a 30-foot cone of needles. Creatures within the cone must make a DC 20 Reflex save or take 4d4 piercing damage and bleed. The damage of the cone increases 1d4 per 2 HD of the creature, and the DC is Constitution-based.

Piercing Needles (Ex)

The quick-cactus deals 1d4 damage plus bleed to any creature who attempts to grapple them. Additionally, any creature that attempts to attack the quick-cactus with a melee natural weapon can make a DC 18 Reflex save. On a failure, you take the damage and bleed.

Water-Weak (Ex)

If exposed to water, like rain, create water, or a river, they are slowed as per the spell for 1d4 rounds.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and hot plains
Organization solitary, trio
Treasure incidental

Quick-cacti developed in arid deserts where water is scarce. They run down their prey, only attacking creatures with blood. They survive primarily off of the blood of creatures they kill. Otherwise, they stay in place conserving their energy and liquids, hidden as mundane cacti, and waiting for prey to pass.
